title: Kurt Cobain’s old apartment is now an Airbnb for Nirvana fans
summary_full: Kurt Cobain’s former studio apartment in downtown Olympia has made its debut as an Airbnb listing, allowing fans a chance to stay where Nirvana’s iconic music was birthed. The cozy apartment, available for a minimum of two nights at $250 to $300 per night, features original decor and memorabilia from Cobain's time. Visitors often rave about the rich history and the convenient location near downtown amenities.
